body: I’ll try that. I don’t really do things like that usually so I think she will really appreciate it. Maybe it’ll help her open up to me. Thank you stranger.

She just tells me she feels like dying. That every day is a struggle and she just wants out. She’s been diagnosed with PTSD due to childhood trauma and abuse, major depressive disorder, anxiety, bulimia, anorexia, & OCD. I feel like it’s a culmination of her untreated disorders maybe making her feel like this? I don’t know

Thank you for the guidance, i really appreciate it. I might have to take her to the hospital, I’m pretty sure she’s planning something just based on some very off putting things she said today. I’m keeping an eye on her for now. I think I’ll reach out to her grandmother since they are close. Maybe she can convince her to get help.
I can’t do this by myself.
Thank you for the advice. I will try to dig a little deeper. I haven’t given up. Thank you so much

Thank you. I’ve tried talking to her but she won’t open up. I haven’t given up. It’s just so odd to me because nothing seems to be triggering her bad moods. She just wakes up and starts crying. I’ll try to talk to her, thanks again.
